note: 2.65.0: the self-triage list (harness/self-triage.mjs). Routine stops the harness fixes by itself, deterministically (no model): each fix is logged as a selftriage.<fix> event naming its cause, and runs at most once per cause per onceHours; a cause that comes back inside that window, and any cause not on this list, still stops for a person. Turn one fix off with "on": false; STUDIO_SELF_TRIAGE=off turns them all off.

reap-orphans.what: a machine:heavy holder whose root process died left its tree running: kill the leftovers (harness/heavy.mjs killHolderTree) and free its slot

rerun-timeout.what: a game check timed out while the machine was loaded (its load factor was above 1, the B-17 timeout line): run it once more at the cap (STUDIO_GAME_GATE_TIMEOUT_MAX_FACTOR x the base); never longer than the cap

switch-tool.what: the supervisor halted because two sessions ended with exit 127/9009 (the tool isn't on PATH): mark that tool out for onceHours so the next tool in the budget order that is on PATH takes over, and clear the halt as studio:resume does (by self-triage)

restart-hub.what: the War Room hub stopped answering while no supervisor runs (a running supervisor restarts it itself): start it again

close-rescues.what: rescue tasks of a task that has landed: close them (task done does this on landing; this is the sweep for any it missed)
